ñcā// ༄/ /snga a+thi+-i yo gter klu〉 bka' brgyad rang shar r+ṣa
༄7/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod dgu pa bzhugs so//
lge/ /gter spon chen po rig 'dzin chong kyi lem 'pha can nam rig 'dzin ngangos gab rgyal mtshan mi/ bod rab byung drug pa'i me glang loga / tsho / / / / sa / da su / / / / / ༄ / /g.yas ru stod byang ga zang zang lha brag gi 'dabs rol ri rgyal bkra bzang gi mdun du bkra shos pa' ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ thugs rigs sad de zab mo baspungs 'dra'am lha brag nas bod khams bde zhing mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i chos skor rnams bse sgrom smug r+ya mdzod lnga'i nang nas rdzogs chen kun bzang dgobyung ba chos tshan brgya phrag lnga lhag spyan drangs shing shog ser las gtan la phab nas skal ldan las can rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ de bzhin gu ru pad+ma'inai ba gnang nga/ 4 ba3da 'dzin ni sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang sdim mtshan ldan ma spruX pa'i 〉spra sbyin/ kun spaX don sbyod rgyal mtshan sogs thugazi kyi
༄tsho/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam dgu pa'i nang bzhugs/ shar dung mdzod dkar po nas byon pa'i bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar la pod lnga bzhugs pa'i dang po la/ gter chen rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis byang zang zang lha brag ngos nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad rang shar gyi dkar chag la/3 (1) byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi smin grol gyi thems byang rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i gsan yig las phyung bar/8(7) byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi thems byang rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i gsan yig las phyung bar/3 (23) drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal por/74 (29) sgrub chen bka' brgyad rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyal tshab rang byung rang shar bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgya can la/55 (177) sgrub chen bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi sngags rgyud rin po che'i gter rgyud la/8 (287) bka' brgyad kyi thems byang zhal gdams la/3 (303) zhi ba gsang chen rigs gcig la/2 (309) rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i sgrub thabs rnam pa lnga por/8 (313) bde gshegs dril sgrub zab mor/5 (329) yang dril rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs la 4
(339) bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi zhi khro dril sgrub la/2 (347) sgrub chen bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi brgyud 'debs la/4 (351) sgrub chen bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi sgrub gzhung chen lngardzor/22 (359) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi sgrub gzhung zur 'debs rab tu zab par gdams pa la/9 (403) bka' brgyad kyi bka' babs spyi don chen mor/12 (421) yum brtag pa'i yig chung la/2 (445) dam bca' yongs rdzogs la/ 2(449) bskang ba bsdus pa dang nyul le brtags shing bzlog par/3 (453) bar gcod 'dul phyir glu bro yongs rdzogs la/3 (459) man ngag yig chung gi skor bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i zur 'debs dang rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi bshad par/ 4 (465) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dngos grub yongs rdzogs bskul ba thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab par5 (473)bka' brgyad kyi brgyud rim la/2 (483) sgrub chen bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi sngon 'gror/5 (487) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi phrin las 'bring por/22 (497) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sngags kyi phrin las la/5 (541) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sgom khog chen mor/8 (551) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha bkod la/6 (567) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dbang gi chu be'i babs so chen por/5
h+la/8dpya/ ltar/dbasgong/zhan/ /pyas/a 'e/ ba supu/ zha dusras/sasurut+ta/ /lo srasangamedab tukhyal pyadabang / /sangs gyas bstan nga dar/dngagyas ngarushas/ / dab//8// // /
༄༅/ /gter chen rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis byang zang zang lha brag ngos nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad rang shar gyi dkar chag bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi pod dang po'i bzhugs byang la ldeb 3/ drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po la ldeb 82/ dbang bskur rin po che'i them byang la ldeb 9/ smin gling gter chen them byang ldeb 3/ bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgya can ldeb 62/ sngags rgyud rin po che'i gter rgyud ldeb 10/ them byang zhal gdams ldeb 3/ zhi ba gsang chen rigs gcig ldeb 1/ rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i sgrub thabs rnam pa lnga ldeb 9/ bde gshegs dril sgrub zab mo ldeb 4/ yang dril rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs ldeb 3/ zhi khro dril sgrub ldeb 1/ brgyud 'debs ldeb 2/ sgrub gzhung chen mo ldeb 25/ sgrub gzhung zur 'debs ldeb 10/ bka' babs spyi don chen po ldeb 12/ yum brtag pa'i yig chung ldeb 1/ dam bca' yongs rdzogs ldeb 6/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i zur
༄tshi/ /'debs dang rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi bshad pa ldeb 4/ dngos grub yongs rdzogs bskul ba ldeb 5/ brgyud rim ldeb 1/ sngon 'gro ldeb 5/ phrin las 'bring po ldeb 24/ sngags kyi phrin las ldeb 4/ sgom khog chen mo ldeb 9/ lha bkod ldeb 6/ dbang gi chu bo babs so chen po ldeb 5/ dbang gi lhan thabs don gsal sgron me nyi zla'i rgyan can ldeb 41/ rtsa ba'i dbang ldeb 39/dbang gi bum sgrub zab mo ldeb 4/ sgrub dbang chen mo'i cho ga'i sdoms chen ldeb 13/ na raka dong sprug ldeb 5/ bskang gso bkol pa ldeb 3/ don bskang rgyas pa ldeb 4/ rab gnas yongs rdzogs ldeb 13/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gsal byed ldeb 11/ swastso'i las rim ldeb 8/ bdun tshigs gnas lung ldeb 12/ gnas lung gi zas gtad ldeb 4/ tshe 'das dgug pa ldeb 1/ sri 'dul ldeb
1 ro sreg phung po gnas sbyong ldeb 5/ 'dzab bskul ldeb 5/ thod brtag ldeb 9/ char 'bebs ldeb 4/ dug khrag gi gdams pa ldeb 2/ phur thun ldeb 2/ gza'i phrin las ldeb 1/ sngags sgrub nang ma ldeb 4/ sngags kyi phreng ba ldeb 5/ dbang gi zur 'debs ldeb 4/ man ngag gsal sgron ldeb 5/ dbang chog rig 'dzin dgongs rgyan ldeb 92/ dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ldeb 1/ bcas bzhugs pa la dpe rkun 'thor brlag ras chod mkhan byung na bka'i srung ma dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cus snying khrag dga' ston tu rol cig zhes pa 'dir ma phyi khungs btsan yin min blos mi dpog par/ yig bri pas sngags bskor pas dbyer ma phyed pa dang / kho bo thos bsam mthu chung bas zab gsang rdo rje'i gsung la zhus dag byed pa dka' rung / gter mdzod du zhugs pa rnams ni de las zhus/ sgrims po'i blo yis dpyad bzod pa dag dang mi bcos su mi rung ba 'ga' zhig ni bcos pas nongs pa'i dri ma mchis na ye shes lha la bshags shing zhes pa nang rgyud yo ga sde gsum la shes rab kyi mig yangs pa mkhyen ldan rnams kyis gzigs bcos bya bar rigs so/ /slar smras pa/ mya/ oX swa sti/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang / /zab gsang bka' yi bsdu ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngo bo dbyer med rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma snying dbus
༄༅/ /thig ler rol/ 1/lhag bsam dri med rab dkar kai lā sha/ /chos la bsam pa'i shes rab nyi 'od kyis/ /'khyud pa'i dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang des/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung rtogs rin po che/2 phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs/ /til gyi tshal bzhin rab tu gangs gyur te/ /thugs mthun khrims gtsang bslab pa gsum gyis mdzes/ 3/ris med bstan 'dzin 'phags mchog dam pa rnams/ /zhabs pad rtags brtan thugs bzhed chos bzhin 'grub/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i ba dan srid rtser bsgreng / /khyad par snga 'gyur bstan pas mdzes gyur cig4 / 'jig rten kun du char chu dus su 'bebs/ /lo phyugs rtag legs mtha' dmag 'khrug rtsod dang / /gnas skabs nad gdon 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs/ /nyer zhi byang chub sems mchog rgyud la skyes/ 5/gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i gdul byar gyur/ /gangs can dus kyi rgud pa kun bsal nas/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog 6/ma lus 'gro ba'i bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /lhan skyes kun brtags ma rig sgrib pa'i mun/ /'od gsal ye shes snying po'i nyin byed kyis/ /yongs gsal 'od lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /zhes pa'ang smar shod a nag lding 7mi
༄༅/ /byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi smin grol gyi them byang rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i gsan yig las phyung ba bzhugs so//
༄༅/ /na mo gu ru ma hā shrī badz+ra he ru ka ya/ byang gter sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i zab gter rab 'byams shig spyan 'dren par mdzad pa'i nang tshan/lho gser mdzod ser po nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar ni/ rgyud las/ zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs nicaX shes pa tsam gyis chog pa yina'oX dran pa tsam gyis lam sna bgrodacaX ye shes nang nas khyad par che'oX lha yi nang nas lha mchog yina'oX de la bsnyen dang sgrub pa dngacaX mchod dang bstod pa thams cad kuna'oX chos kyi dbyings su mngon 'tshang rgya'oX zhes ches cher bsngags pa'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sgrub gzhung gi steng nas sta gon dang / rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis logs su bkod pa'i rtsa ba'i dbang ngam bsnyen pa gso ba'i dbang chog
༄༅/ /gi steng nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ me tog phreng ba nus pa'i dbang / rig pa'i dbang lnga / sman rag gtor gsum phyag mtshan rgyan dbang / lha dbang / byang sems la brten nas gsang dbang phyag rgya la brten nas sher dbang / brda dang ngo sprod la brten nas tshig dbang / lta sgom spyod pa'i dbang / mtha' rten sgrol dbang dang bcas pa/ tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / bya khyung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rnams legs par mnos/ rgyud dang khrid gzhung rnams kyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i khrid/ gyes pa yal ga lta bu'i khrid/smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i khrid yig bka' brgyad kyi dgongs pa snying tig thams cad kyi srog ma tshang ba med par skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du rgyal dbang pad+mas rgyud las gud du phyung ba la
gzhi byas/ khri srong rnam sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i rim lnga gdan thog gcig tu sgom pa'i khrid yig rang lus 'byung gzhi 'dus pa'i brag ri dug lnga'i sbrul gyis kun nas spungs pa'i dbus nas dgongs gter du byung ba dang / gter byon gnam zhal don khrid gnyis bsdebs rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun gyis legs par brgyan te dbang po mtha' ma'i rim pa gsum la nyan rang dbu sems kyi khrid/dbang po 'bring gi rim pa gsum la byang sems kri yog u pa gsum gyi khrid/ gnam zhal don khrid nas gsungs pa'i yo ga gsum la brten pa'i lha khrid/ dbang po rab kyi tha ma la gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rtsa rlung gi khrid/ dbang po rab kyi 'bring la sher dbang dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi khrid/ rang byung rang shar le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba lus dben/ ngag dben/ sems dben/ sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug dbang po rab kyi rab la ye shes zang thal dang yid mthun pa sgom mi dgos par mthong bas grol ba 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po snang bzhi'i khrid rnams smin rgyas su mnos/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ them byang las/ rgyud chen gnyis kyis thog drangs nas4༷༷ bskyed rim chos tshan brgya rtsa brgyadagiX rdzogs rim chos tshan bcu gcig yodagiX shin tu gces shing dam par bcadagiX rtse gcig sgrub la nyams su longs4༷༷ zhes pa ltar/ rgyud kyis
༄tshi/ /thog drangs pa'i bskyed rim gdams pa'i skor/ rdzogs rim grol byed kyi skor dang gnyis las/ dang po la/ rtsa rgyud kyi skor/ sgrub pa phrin las/ smin byed dbang rim/ nyams chag dag byed skor/ rang gzhan phan bde 'byung thabs/ gshen la phan gdags pa/ nad gdon bar gcod bzlog thabs/ bsod nams tshogs bsog thun mong chos spyod/ phan gnod las phran/ chos spyad bstan srung / yongs rdzogs rnam gsum nyams len lha khrid kyi rim pa dang bcu gsum/ dang po la drag po rang byung rang shar chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u nyer drug pa/ o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgya gar dang o rgyan gyi sgra gnyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ rang byung rang shar rtsa ba'i rgyud dam/ rgyal tshab rang byung rang shar du byon pa le'u nyer lnga pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgya can/ zhi khro bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i sngags rgyud rin chen phreng ba le'u bco lnga pa / rgyud le'u nyer drug pa'i grangs nges mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis mdzad pa des mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi las rim rtsa ba gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i gsang rgyud rtsa sdom gyis bsdus pa rnam par phye ba rnams/ gnyis pa sgrub pa phrin las kyi skor la them byang zhal gdams le'u brgyad pa/ zhi ba gsang chen rigs gcig gi sgrub pa/ rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ gyes pa yal ga lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ rgyas pa lo 'dab lta bu'i sgrub
thabs / mdzes pa me tog lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ bde gshegs rtsa ba dril sgrub snying gi gter/ rtsa ba yang dril gyi sgrub thabs/ rang byung rang shar rgyud mchog snying po'i bcud/zhi khro'i dril sgrub rang byung rang shar chen po'i bcud/ bka' brgyad brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs khyab bdag mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs 'og min chos dbyings ma/ drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i sgrub gzhung chen mo/ bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i sgrub gzhung zur 'debs/ sgrub pa rgyas pa'i lag len bka' babs spyi don chen mor grags pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi gsung / sgrub pa'i yum brtag pa'i yig chung / sgrub chen skabs mnga' gsol bya ba'i yig chung dam bca' bkol ba/ rgyun bshags nar ma mchod skong bsdus pa bar chad myul le rgyas par brtags te bzlog pa rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi bshad pa/ bdud rtsi rtsa ba sgrub pa'i zur 'debs/ dngos grub yongs rdzogs bskul ba/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad dus gsum rgyal ba yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las sngon 'gro drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i phrin las 'bring po/ gsang ba sgrub chen las khrid yi dam rgyun khyer du grags pa sngags kyi sgrub pa/ bka' brgyad phrin las kyi skabs su mkho ba'i sgom khog bstod pa chos sku skye med ma/ bka' brgyad
༄༅/ /gdan gyi rnam par dbye ba mnga' ris paṇa chen kyis lho brag tu mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i lha bskyed pa'i gdan lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi tshul zur du bkol ba rnams/ gsum pa smin byed dbang gi rim pa la / bka' brgyad kyi dbang gi chu bo'i babs so chen po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud gyi nyams len lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu man ngag tu dril ba nyon mongs dug sbrul spungs pa'i sgyu lus kyi brag ri chen po'i nang nas lha rigs pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis dgongs gter du phyung ba/ rang byung rang shar gyi dbang gi lhan thabs don gsal sgron me nyi zla'i rgya can/ rtsa dbang bkol ba'am bsnyen pa gso ba'i dbang du grags pa dpal sngags kyi srung ma rdo rje khro gdong mar gnyer du gtad pa'i mtha' can/ bka' brgyad dbang gi bum sgrub/ dus bsnyen sgrub dbang gi khrid kyi sgrub dbang chen mo'i cho ga'i sdom du grags pa/ slob ma sta gon bkol ba lha gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag mtshan rnams kyi lha bkod rnams/ bzhi pa nyams chag dag byed skor la/ phyi yi bshags pa na rag dong sprug dam tshig gso ba'i bskang gso bkol ba'o/ /lnga pa rang gzhan phan bde 'byung thabs la / 'gro ba'i bsod nams tshogs rdzogs par bya ba sku gsung thugs rten gyi rab gnas bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud las byung ba/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg yongs rdzogs rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud las
byung ba/ sku gdung swastso'i las rim zhes pa ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dgos ched bzhed thabs/ 'bras bu rnams bstan pa las/ nam mkha' rlung chu me'i swasmo dag po'i sanywa sdig pa sbyong ba'i swasmo gshin po'i don byed kyi swasmo 'chi bdag bzlog cing sri'u gso ba'i swasmo bsod nams rgyas pa'i swasmo skol ba 'joms pa'i swasmo kaka kha dang zor kha bzlog pa'i swatsā khims nyams g.yo ba'i swasmo lhams chag gso ba'i sāts+tsha rnams/ mdze 'phro gcod pa'i sāts+tsha rnams/ drug pa gshin la phan gdags pa la/ bdun tshigs/ zas gtad tshe 'das dgug cing gshed dang bral ba/ gnas spar ba/ ro bsreg rnams/ bdun pa nad gdon bar gcod bzlog thabs la/ rang byung rang shar gyi rig 'dzin spyi bskul 'og min chos dbyings ma/ bstod bskul las bzhi lhun grub/ bskul ba chung ba mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rdzogs pa'i mtha' can / dkon mchog spyi bskul lam skul chen mor grags pa mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rnal 'byor bar gcod bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig pa'i mtha' can/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi drag las bkol ba'am bsgral las don brgyad ma bsad pa'i las bzhi lhan tu gsal ba/ bden bdar chen mo rdo rje theg pa'i lha tshogs spyi la mkhyen par gsol ba/ ral gri phyung rdeg ces pa nang gses kyi snyan gsan/ gzu dpang dgug
༄༅/ /gzhug ye shes kyi lha tshogs bzhengs par gsol ba bla ma yi dam rnams bskul bar dpe tshan gcig tshe lung khrus lung / khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog gi rtsa ba/ sa bcad zlog gzhung chen mo'i tsheg bar dgu ma 'debs kha dgu ni/ gshin rje ma mo rgyal po klu the'u rang btsan gza' bdud srin po bzlog pa/ las phran bcu ni/ shi kha gcod pa bse rag kha ching smyo 'dul ser bsrung nad kha gcod pa/ tshe sgrub nad pa bsrung ba zho chang bsrung ba/ sde brgyad kyi gshom rnams/ brgyad pa bsod nams tshogs gsog la/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyi gtor nang gi gtor ma gsang ba'i gtor ma thun mong chu sbyin/ cha gsum gtor ma/ spyi don drug pa/ cha gsum bsdus pa rnams/ dgu pa thun mong chos spyod la/ ldang ba khrus phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ bza' tshogs skom gos/ 'gro 'chag nyal ba/ 'dug pa/ bskor ba/ sbyin pa/ nad gdon gzhom pa rnams yod cing chos spyod nyer gcig gsungs pa'i 'ga' zhig ni chos tshan gzhan du kha 'phangs don gyis tshang ngo / /ngag gi nus 'don sgrib tshogs 'dag pa'i cho ga rnams/ bcu pa phan gnod las phran la/ shes rab bskyed pa dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub pa/ dug khrag yongs rdzogs sbyor ba/ bsrung zlog gnam lcags me 'bar/ bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i drag sngags/ de'i las rim brgyad la drag sngags bsnyen pa skyel ba/
rnal 'byor sgrib pa sbyong ba/ chos skyong las la bskul ba/ sde brgyad bran du bkol ba/ rigs bzhi'i klu rnams 'dul ba/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gdul ba/ bar gcod bgegs dpung gzhom pa/ ba ling gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /de'i 'phros las/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs drag sngags kyi bsnyen pa'i rtags yig dam can srog 'bor bskor ba/ sde brgyad gnad dbab/ mdze gso ba sbyin sreg rbod gtong bzlog pa/rang 'khor bsrung ba/ sri'u gso ba/ smyon pa 'dul ba/ zho chang bsrung ba/ nag po dgu sbyor mi gcig pa gnyis la brten nas mdze lhog shu 'brum bsrung ba/ zor dang sbyin sreg mnan pa'i las/ thub chod kun dril gyi bzlog pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i drag sngags kyi dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol zhing bzlog pa/ seng gdong dmar mo'i skor la/ rtsa sgrub chos sgrub/ dbang sdud/ nor sgrub/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ rims bsrung ba/ gshags 'gan pa/ phyogs ngan bdud gcod bsrung ba/ mtshon srung 'khrug gral du 'gro ba'i dus na bsrung ba/ gtor ma/ bstod bskul rab 'jigs dur khrod ma rnams/ sngags sdeb kyi lag len snying gi ti ga yongs rdzogs skyin thang dbab pa/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi sgrub pa shīn+ti gar+bha dang slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs kyi brnag pa rnams/ bcu gcig pa chos skyong bstan srung skor la/ sde dpon sum cu bsgrub pa'i
༄༅/ /las byang ngam snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi ngan sngags bsgrub pa'i las byang o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa mnga' bdag sde dpon sum cu'i bstod bskul rgyas pa/ dbang phyug ma hā de ba ma/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i phyi sgrub mdos kyi man ngag phyi sgrub mdos kyi bca' thabs sam mdos byang chen mor grags pa gyer gzhung sogs rgyas pa gtor ma'i bshom/ sde dpon sum cu'i nang sgrub/ mchod pa gsol ka/ gsang sgrub srog snying rnams bstan pa las tshogs lnga bcu par grags pa/ sde dpon sum cu'i sgrub gzhung zhes pa'i nang tshan la bdag nyid chen po'i sbyor ba/ thabs shes/ gnas su 'dug pa/ 'gro ba 'thon pa/ 'bod pa ma byung bar 'bod pa/ bskyar zhing 'bod pa/ dmigs rten lha dang dpral ba/ bshags : thun za 'khrul 'khor : rdzas las bkye/ dmag mi/ cha gsum du bgo ba/ gtad bro/ spogs pa rnams ston pa/'di gsan yig gzhan phal cher la mi 'dug kyang rig 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig na 'dug pas nges gnas so/ /gzhan yang rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po pho nya yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las rnams/ klu bdud nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mu stegs kyi ngan sngags dbang phyug chen po'i bzlog pa/ dbang phyug chen mo'i bzlog sngags dngos/ u ma'i snying tig dbang phyug ro
langs phyin ci log rdo rje mi bzlog rnams kyang thob/ bcu gnyis pa yongs rdzogs rnam gsum la/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs su bskur ba'i dbang chog tshe sgrub yongs rdzogs/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las/bstod pa bcom ldan mgon po ma/ 'chi med tshe yi pra brtag pa/ phyi sgrub 'chi med bdud rtsi yongs rdzogs/ nang tshe sgrub kun gyi don bsdus nas bsgrub pa/ gsang sgrub hrīXgacig ma/ yang gsang nam mkha' rdo rje/khyung chen gdug pa 'dul ba'i rgyud chen/ bya khyung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur/ rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub pa/ gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las/ nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur rjes gnang zab mo/ nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ nor bdag las mkhan dzo dmar gsang ba gsum dril gyi sgrub pa rnams/ bcu gsum pa nyams len lha khrid kyi rim pa ni/ bka' brgyad kyi lha khrid bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgom pa'i gnad o rgyan chen pos phyi rabs kyi don du mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rdzogs rim grol byed kyi skor la rdzogs rim gyi khrid gzhung ye shes zang thal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam chen mo mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'tshang rgya bar byed pa 'pho ba/ bar do gsum gyi zhal gdams/ rdzogs rim snying tig gi skor la/ sgrol lam gshin rje'i snying tig gsung
༄tsho/ /mchog pad+ma'i snying tig thugs mchog yang dag snying tig bdud rtsi yon tan snying tig phrin las phur pa'i snying tig chags lam ma mo'i snying tig rig 'dzin bla ma'i snying tig 'jig rten dregs pa'i snying tig drag sngags dmod pa'i snying tig spyi dril snying po'i snying tig gnam zhal don khrid zab mo/ rtsa ba sdong po gyes pa/yal ga smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i khrid thams cad tshang ba tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen du/ rgyal dbang pad+mas rgyud las phyung ba/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi dgongs gter rang byung rang shar gyi le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba'i ldogs rim gyi rgyal po rim lnga gdan gcig ma dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi dbang dang rgyud chen gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang che mchog he ru ga longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/ smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po in+t+ra bhu ti/ dpal gyi sprul pa rnam brgyad/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po/ rgyal sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/ rig 'dzin sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ldong gi sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rje btsun sprul sku chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/
rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang po/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston yab 4ma/ dbyangs ma/khyen brtse'igayo yig ltar na rtsa ba rgyu'idabang bzhi'ibargyud pa 'digaco che bar ma/jad do/ sras nas/rgyal sras bsod nams bzang po/ grub chen dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ skye med rdo rje grags pa/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas skyob/ mkhon ston byams pa dpal bzang / rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man sngar ltar/yang dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas thugs sras legs bzang / sngags 'chang lha dpal bzang po/ grub chen don grub rin chen/ de gnyis ka la/ bla ma dkon mchog blo gros/ de la se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med spyan tshab chen po/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal bkra shos stobs rgyal man gong ltar ro/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs/ khyung chen yongs rdzogs/ nor lha yongs rdzogs gsum gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams yan gong ltar la/ de nas thugs sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shos/ gnubs chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ grub mchog tshe ring dbang po rang grol klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ drin can chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ yang na bsod nams bkra shos nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug skyi
༄tshi/ /ston tshe ring dbang po man gong 'dra/ nyams khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams yan gong ltar la/ de nas yol mo shākya bzang po/ paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal/ bla ma don yod bzang po skyi ston tshe ring dbang po man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na chos rgyal bsod nams nas/ thugs sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang rgya mtsho man gong 'dra/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyud dang phrin las ma gtogs pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston yab sras nas/ zur tsho pa rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang po/ gnya' nang pa gu ru dbang phyug mgon po/ ban 'brog rdo rje gling pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bka' brgyad zhal gzigs glo bo dzar pa sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams/ brang so sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal maṅga'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen mkhyen rab dbang phyug nas legs ldan rje la brgyud do/ /gnod sbyin nag po'i rgyud dang phrin las kyi brgyud pa ni/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs yan yongs rdzogs skor gsum dang 'dra ba la/ de nas khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag
༄7/ /byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi them byang rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i gsan yig las phyung ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ya/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam 'phrul byang gter rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru'i zab gter mdzod lnga'i nang tshan/ lho gser mdzod ser po nas byon pa'i bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi skor thob pa la dbang lung gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub gzhung rtsa ba'i dbang chog gi steng nas dbang bzhi bsgral dbang dang bcas pa nod nas/ gnyis pa la/bskyed rim chos tshan brgya rtsa brgyad/ rdzogs rim chos tshan bcu gcig yod ces spyir bshad kyang bye brag gi them mi snang bas/ skabs don 'brel mtshungs su bsdebs na bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dang po la / rtsa ba rgyud/ bsnyen sgrub/ sgrub chen/ chog 'phrin/ dbang chog gshegs skong / las chen/ las phran/ bstan srung / sgrub phran gyi skor dang bcu las/ dang po la/ them byang / lo rgyus spyi don/
༄༅/ /rang shar rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u nyer drug pa/ de'i le don/ rang shar rgyal tshab rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa/ de'i le don/ sgrub thabs rim lnga le'u lnga pa/ sngags rgyud le'u bcu drug pa/ gnyis pa la/zhi ba dril sgrub/ khro bo dril sgrub/ bde gshegs rtsa ba'i dril sgrub snying gter/ yang dril gyi sgrub thabs/ zhi khro'i dril sgrub/ lha khrid dpe ma rnyed gcig pa/ lta sgom spyod 'bras mdo byang du dril ba shes bya bcu'i man ngag rnams so/ /gsum pa la/ rang shar sgrub gzhung chen mo/ de'i zur 'debs/ yum brtag pa/ las tshan mnga' gsol/ dam bca' rgyun bshags/ mchod skong / nyul le/brtag zlog dngos grub bskul byang / dkyil 'khor don bstod/ gtso bo'i bstod pa/ thig le man ngag sman sgrub ṭīk+ka/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i zur 'debs/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi ngos 'dzin
thod pa'i mnga' gsol bcas/ bdud rtsi'i las tshogs/ bzhi pa la/ phrin las sngon 'gro rang shar phrin las 'bring po/ sngags sgrub phrin las/ bstod byang bkol ba/ rgyun bstod/ 'dzab bskul/ lnga pa la / dbang gi chu bo'i babs so/ dbang gi rtsa ba thugs kyi gter gcig ma/ dbang gi bum sgrub/ lha dbang bskur thabs/ dus bsnyen sgrub dbang chen mo/ drug pa la/ na rag dong sprug gi cho ga rgyud las phyung ba / bskang gso bkol ba/ don skong / bdun pa la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gtor chog cha gsum gtor ma/ ldang khrus sogs thun mong chos spyod kyi las rim/ bdun tshigs gnas lung gi cho ga bu yig dgug cing gshed 'bral/ zas gtad/ spubs shig ro sreg sku gdung sāts+tsha kha bsgyur gyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga las bzhi'i sbyin sreg glu bro'i man ngag khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog gi rtsa ba sa bcad zlog gzhung dang bcas pa/ rig 'dzin spyi bskul/ bstod bskul las bzhi lhun grub/ rgyal ba spyi bskul/ dkon mchog spyi bskul/ pho nya dgos bskul/ bsgral las bsad pa las bcu/ dam brdar chen mo/ ral gri phyungs rdeg gi drag bskul/ tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa/ man ngag dmod byang bkol ba/ las kyi kha sgyur 'debs kha dgu dang las phran bcu'i man ngag srung zlog gnam lcags me 'bar/
༄tshi/ /drag sngags so lnga pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ brgyad pa la/ sngags sdebs/ dug khrag sbyor thabs/ char 'bebs/ ser srung / ngag gi ngar glud/ ser 'bebs/ bu yig gza'i phrin las / thub chod kun dril gyi zlog pa/ thod brtag rnams/ dgu pa la sde dpon sum cu'i sgrub gzhung / phyi sgrub mdos kyi man ngag de'i bya thabs mdos gzhung / nang sgrub gsol kha/ gsang sgrub srog snying las tshogs lnga bcu pa/ sde dpon gyi las byang / bstod bskul rnams so/ /bcu pa la/ tshe dbang / tshe sgrub/ phrin las/ bstod pa/ phyi sgrub bcud len/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ hrīXgacig ma/ yang gsang nam mkha'i rdo rje rnams/ khyung chen gdug pa 'dul ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ dbang bskur/ khyung gi sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs rnams/ nor lha'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs phrin las/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/las mkhan gsang ba gsum dril gyi sgrub thabs rnams/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rdzogs rim skor la/ khrid gzhung ye shes zang thal/ 'pho ba'i man ngag bar do gsum gyi zhal gdams/ snying tig dgu'i man ngaggnam zhal don khrid zab mo/ rang shar gyi gzhung khrid srog shing lta bu rgyud las pad+mas bkol ba rnams so/ /de ltar rdzogs par mnos pa'i bla brgyud ni/ kun bzang / he ru ka rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje chos/ smug nag
༄༅: drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs so:

༄tshicaX par bstan du gsolacaX zhes zhus socaX de nas rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur ba chen pos bka' stsal pa'oX nyon cig gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzina'oX 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi'oX byung tshul thog mar 'di lta stecaX cir yang ma grub gang yang mina'oX yod med rtag chad gnyis las 'dasacaX gdos pa'i gzugs min 'dus byas mina'oX rig pa med cing dran pa medacaX rdul phra rab kyis ma bskyed cingacaX 'byung ba lnga la ma brten pa'oX snying pos mi 'jig tha snyad bralacaX sangs rgyas sgam pos mdzad pa mina'oX sems can sgrin pos bcos pa medacaX 'khor 'das gnyis ga'i don ma grubacaX mtha' med dbus med sgro skur bralacaXrtogs dang ma rtogs rig pa medacaX 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ma rig medacaX dper na nam mkha' lta bu'ocaX 'dus ma byas pas brjod du medacaX ngos bzung med pas stong pa 'dra'oX dran rig med pas bem po 'dra'oX

༄tshicaX byol song chen po brgyad kyi khri steng du/ srid pa'i 'ber lo log pa'i lam gyi drwa ba gcod pasacaX 'khor lo'i gdan lnga chos kyi sku las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dpal che mchog he ru ka zhes bya ba dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sa non pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa gleng gzhi'i le'u bdun pa las gsungs so/ /yang le'u brgyad pa'i che mchog gi sgrub pa'i skabs las/ khyad par byol song khri steng du'oX ye shes sems dpa' babs gyur te'oX zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /le'u dgu pa che mchog dbu dgu pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs su gsungs pa ni/ de nas gdan gyi bye brag nicaX dregs pa 'gro drug byol song stengacaX dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su gdingacaX rgyu yi ye shes sems dpa' lasacaX cho ga gsum gyi sbyor ba yisacaX che mchog he ru'i skur bskyed bya'oX dbu dgu phyag kyang bco brgyad pa'oX
zhabs kyang rnam pa brgyad du bgradagiX ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /le'u bcu pa che mchog dbu gsum phyag drug pa'i skabs su byung ba ni/ dregs pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan4༷༷ kun las khyad par shes par bya4༷༷gdan steng rgyu yi byin rlabs la4༷༷ bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaX mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug pagiX zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /khro bo smyi sgrub las gsungs pa rnams so/ /zhi khro rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi sgos sgrub che mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi skabs su gsungs pa/ phyi nang med par gsal ba'i nangagiX lha brgyad klu brgyad bsnol ba dngagiX byol song gtso bo brgyad kyi stengagiX hūm̐X las che mchog he ru kaX zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa che mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u gsum pa'i skabs su gsungs pa/ ka ba rin chen pad+ma dngagiX 'khor lo dag gis nges par byas4༷༷ zhes pas gzhung bzhin gnas lugs mtshon pa gdan gyi skabs su / dregs pa'i bdag po lha chen brgyadagiX thabs dang shes rab 'od kyi dkyil4༷༷ 'dam skyes mdzes pa bsam mi khyabaltoX ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /rtsa rgyud kyi yang dag skabs su/ khyu mchog ma he gzig dang stagagiX gtum po dom gyi spar ba nigiX dbang phyug lha chen la sogs gzungagiX nyi zla pad+ma'i zhing gi gdan4༷༷ rim gyis gsal bar bskyed steng dugiX zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dngagiX yang dag rtsa brgyud kyi
༄tshiltoX bsnyen sgrub bsdus pa'i le'u bzhi par gsungs pa'i skabs su bstan pa/ drag po'i gnas kyi dbus dag tugiX rū tra nyi zla pad+ma'i stengagiX gnas g.yin rnams su ti ra'ogiX zhes gsungs 'jam dpal gyi skabs su gsungs pa/ ma he chu glang zhing gi gdan4༷༷ steng du 'jam dpal gshen rje gshedagiX ces gsungs/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las rang gi gdan gyi bye brag gsungs pa/ a dang moX dang paṃ dag las4༷༷ gsal la snying po bsil byed can4༷༷ dag pa gsung las spyad pas brnyes4༷༷ ma he chu glang brjid pa nigiX stag gi rnam par spro las byungagiX de dag steng du bsgom pa nigiX hūṃX chen 'bar ba'i 'od phros pas4༷༷ zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i don ni/ a las zla ba moX las nyi ma paṃ las pad+ma de'i steng du chu glang dom ma he'i gdan bkod par gsungs so/ /dbang chen rtsa ba'i rgyud las rta mgrin gyi gdan gsungs pa/ stong gsum gyi klu'i rgyal po gdug pa can gdan du byas pa ni nyon mongs pa'i dug ma lus pa 'joms pa'i rang bzhin pad+ma rnam par dag pa'i gdan byas pa nigiX thugs rje'i sems can la chags par mdzad kyang de'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rang bzhin nyi ma dngagiX zla ba pad+ma 'bar ba'i 'od kyis btegs pa ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam par dag pas bskyed pa stegiX zhes pa la sogs pa le'u dang po las gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa las klu pho mo

༄tshiltoX pa'i stengagiX thabs shes nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil4༷༷ ma chags pad+ma'i ge sar la4༷༷ bcom ldan che mchog he ru kaX zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /rang byung rang shar las/ gzhal yas de yi dkyil dbus sugiX rdo rje'i brag dang pad+ma dngagiX nyi zla klu brgyad sgyel ba'i stengagiX seng ge stag gzig glang po chegiX dom dang ma he chu srin sbrul4༷༷ dud 'gro brgyad kyi khri steng dugiX gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pagiX steng na dregs pa lha brgyad brdzis4༷༷ de steng che mchog he ru kaX zhes pa la sogs gsal bar gsungs so/ /bskyed pa ma hā yo ga las4༷༷ khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i brdar byol song gtso bo brgyad seng ge glang po sbrul ma he stag gzig dom chu glang dang brgyad dogiX de'i steng du 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos shong sa dgu gnon pa'i brdar pad+ma'i gdan no4༷༷ thabs shes zung 'brel nyi zla'i gdan gyis srid pa gsum gyi 'gran zla dang bral zhing rgyal byed dpa' rtags su lha chen ma hā de ba dngagiX u ma de ba gnyis sngon dmar byi chings su bsnol ba'i steng du gsal bar bskyed dogiX zhes pa tsam las rgyas par ma bstan pa'i phyir klu brgyad ma bstan pa dang /gzhan du ma hā de ba gnyis ma bshad pa dang / brtsegs lugs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams gsal bar ma gsungs pa/ rang byung rang shar las bzhi lhun grub kyi nang nas byung ba rnams kyis kha skong bar rigs te deng
sang bka' brgyad la thugs 'dris pa rnams kyis/ gdan gyi lha klu byol song gi kha dog phyag mtshan rgyan chas 'gyel stabs rnams zhib tu dpyad pa mdzad par zhus shigagiX kho bo pad+ma dbang rgyal ni re shig don bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes lho brag gi gnas gzhir bka' brgyad kyi lha bkod byed kyis smras pa'o/ /shubhe/ yang drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud las/ gru bzhi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i dbus4༷༷ mthing nag gru gsum lte ba la4༷༷ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma dngagiX dud 'gro gtso bo rnam pa brgyadagiX rū tra dregs pa bsgyel ba'i stengagiX hūṃX las che mchog he ru gagiX smug nag nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal4༷༷ zhes bya ba'i don ni/ gru gsum gyi lte ba la pad+ma'i steng du zla ba dang de'i steng du nyi ma de'i steng du dud 'gro gtso brgyad rū tra dregs pa bsgyel ba'i steng du dbu nyer gcig pa bskyed par gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ gzhal yas de yi dkyil dbus sugiX rdo rje'i brag dang pad+ma dngagiX nyi zla klu brgyad bsgyel ba'i stengagiX seng ge stag gzig glang po chegiX dom dang ma he chu srin sbrul4༷༷ dud 'gro brgyad kyi khri steng dugiX gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pagiX steng na dregs pa lha brgyad brdzis4༷༷ de steng che mchog he ru kaX zhes gsungs pa/ 'og rdo rje'i brag steng du pad+ma de'i steng du nyi ma de'i steng du zla ba de'i steng du klu brgyad bsgyel ba'i steng du byol song brgyad de'i steng du gser gyi 'bar lo rtsibs bcugiX de'i
༄khultoX steng na dregs pa'i lha brgyad brdzis pa'i steng du che mchog dbu nyer gcig pa bskyed par gsungs so/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'igiX dbus su zla gam e yi dkyil4༷༷ pad+ma nyi zla rū tra'i stengagiXdpal chen badz+ra he ru kaX zhes gsungs pas pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma zla ba rū tra rnams rim par steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /lho phyogs 'bor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'igiX zla gam gru gsum mthing nag la4༷༷ pad+ma nyi zla ma he'i khrigiX gzhin rje pho mo'i gdan steng dugiX sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshedagiX ces gsungs pa dang / nub phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ pad+ma nyi zla klu brgyad stengagiX gsung mchog pad+ma he ru gagiXzhes dngagiX byang phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i stengagiX 'phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i skugiX zhes dang / shar lho 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ pad+ma nyi ma ma mo'i stengagiX mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru kaX zhes dang / lho nub 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ pad steng nyi zla seṅge'i khrigiX dar dpyangs lnga yi gdan steng dugiX dpal chen rdo rje drag po rtsal4༷༷ zhes dang / nub byang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ pad+ma nyi zla lha chen stengagiX dregs pa phyag na rdo rje nigiX zhes dang / byang shar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus4༷༷ dgra bgegs pad+ma nyi zla'i stengagiX drag po stobs ldan ha la'i skugiX zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs
so gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las kyang lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi gdan gnyis gsungs so/ /'di yang pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis zur du bkod pa maṅga liṃ/ lha gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag mtshan rnams kyi lha bkod yod dbus kyi gtso kro yab yum gnyis so so'i sku mdog rgyan cha lugs sogs ma t+pū lta bur bris te phyag mtshan rnams 'di ltar du bri'o/ /yab kyi phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis na thod rlon bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du/sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams pa/ nang du sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yongs rdzogs mi thon pas sku smad mgrin pa man chad thod pa'i nang du gzhugs pa'i tshul du byas/ thod pa rnams kyi steng du lha rnams kyi dbu tsam re sku mdog ma nor bar bri ba ni/ phyag g.yas nyi shu rtsa gcig na dbu dang po mthing / gnyis pa sngo/ gsum pa dkar/ bzhi pa ser/ lnga pa dmar/ drug pa ljang / bdun pa dkar/ brgyad pa dkar/ dgu pa sngo/ bcu pa ser/ bcu gcig dmar/ bcu gnyis dmar/ bcu gsum ljang / bcu bzhi dkar/ de rnams zhi ba'i dbu'o/ /bco lnga pa khro bo dkar/ bcu drug pa ser/ bcu bdun pa dmar/ bco brgyad pa ljang bcu dgu pa thub pa dkar/ nyi shu pa sngo/ nyer gcig pa thub pa ser po/ de gsum sprul sku'i dbu'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rdzogs so/ /phyag g.yon nyi shu rtsa gcig na/ dang po mthing / gnyis pa sngo/
༄༅ltoX gsum pa dkar/ bzhi pa ser/ lnga pa dmar/ drug pa ljang / bdun pa dkar/ brgyad pa sngo/ dgu pa dmar/ bcu pa ljang / bcu gcig dkar/ bcu gnyis pa ser/ bcu gsum pa dmar/ bcu bzhi pa ljang / de rnams zhi ba'i dbu'o/ /bco lnga khro bo dkar/ bcu drug ser/ bcu bdun pa dmar/ bco brgyad ljang / bcu dgu thub pa seng ge'i mgo nyi shu thub pa dmar/ rtsa gcig pa mthing nag ste sprul sku'i dbu'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyi phyag 'tshan rdzogs so/ /yum gyi phyag mtshan ni g.yas dang po rdo rje yab la stob/ g.yon pa dang po thod khrag stob pa'o/ /de 'og g.yas pa'i brgyad ni dang po khro mo dkar/ gnyis pa ser gsum pa dmar/ bzhi pa nag lnga pa ser / drug pa ljang / bdun pa mthing / brgyad pa ser po'o/ /thams cad khro mo'i cha byad yin/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rdzogs so/ /phyag g.yon dang po seng mgognyis pa lhag wagadong / gsum pa wa gdong / bzhi pa spyang gdong / lnga pa rgod gdong / drug pa dur bya nag mgo bdun pa bya rog mgo brgyad pa 'ug mgo de rnams mgo brnyan no/ /yum gyi phyag mtshan rdzogs
༄༅: sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dbang gi chu bo babs so chen po bzhugs so: :
༄tshicaX na mo gu ru hūṃXcaX dbang gi bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka nyid kun tu bzangacaX phyogs dus rgyal ba yongs rdzogs zhi dang khro gar 'dod dgu bsgyuracaX gang la gang gis 'dul mdzad chos bka' rim dang cig car stona'oX phyag 'tshal rgyud lung man ngag yongs rdzogs dbang gi khrigs zab lngardzocaX sbyang gzhi rab sbyong smin grol gsang sngags kun mtha' 'god par bya'oX spyir chos thams cad bsdu na rnam pa gsum stecaX gang sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi dngacaX gang gis sbyong bar byed pa'i gnyen po dngacaX ji ltar sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs socaX dang po gang sbyong bar byed pa'oX gzhi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad de'oXbsdus rtsa na rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la 'dus socaX gang gis sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cadacaX de bsdu na rgyud lung man ngag gsum du 'dus socaX ji ltar sbyong ba'i thabs lam gyi
༄tshicaX rim pa thams cad gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du 'dus pasacaX de don nyams su blang thabs thams cad yongs rdzogs dbang bskur la brten nasacaX bskyed rdzogs gsum 'dus pa'i phyiracaX yongs rdzogs dbang bskur gyi rim pa bstan pa nicaX rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po'oX zhes gsungs pas don rnam pa bcus bstan te'oX dang po dbang gi babs socaX ngo bo dngacaX nges tshigacaX dbye bcaX bskur thabasacaX dam tshigacaX ma thob pa'i skyona'oX thob pa'i 'bras bu'oX yon dbul bcaX gtad rgya bstan pa'ocaX dang po dbang gi chu bo bzhi'i rgyun ma chad par bstan pa nicaX ye nas ma bcos pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum gyisacaX 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du rgyal ba rigs rnam pa lnga la ye shes lnga'i rtsal dbang yongs rdzogs bskur te'oX gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs
pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa rdzogs par shar te4༷༷ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas yab yum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dugiX thugs rje'i bdag nyid thub pa chen po drug tu sprul nas4༷༷'gro ba 'dul bar dbang bskuraltoX khyad par du dam pa tog dkar po la yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskuraltoX sku gsung thugs kyi 'gro ba 'dul bar byin gyis rlabs4༷༷ phyi nang theg pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bka' stsalaltoX des kyang sprul pa gsum gyis 'gro don mdzad degiX phyi ltar mi yul du shākya thub par sku sprul te4༷༷ sngags t+pū pa kri yog sde gsum gsungs te4༷༷ lag na rdo rje la kro yog gi dbang lung wā ra na sir mdzad nas gtadagiX nang ltar du 'og min gnas su rdo rje 'chang chen por sprul nas4༷༷ gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs gsum gsungs te rdo rje chos la dbang lung rdzogs par bskur nas gtadagiX gsang ba ltar na kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpar sku sprul te4༷༷ a ti yo ga'i rgyud lung man ngag rnams gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du gsang ba'i bdag po la dbang smyi 'byams yongs rdzogs su bskur nas a ti gsang bltoX yang gsang a tigiXgsang ba yang gsangagiX yang ti spyi ti'i skor rnams bka' gtad dogiX de nas rgya gar du dbang gi chu bo bzhir babs tshul nigiX bka' pu sti glegs bam gyi dbang bskur nas thob pa dngagiX yi dam lha yis dbang bskur
